meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用CLI创建、预览和渲染超帧动画与视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要开发超帧动画并用命令行管理渲染
copy.tagline_en: Create, preview, and render hyperframe animations and videos using the CLI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop hyperframe animations and manage rendering from the command line

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 HyperFrames CLI 开发视频合成项目：初始化项目、编写合成、检查错误、预览动画、渲染视频，并处理云渲染、子合成等。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建或编辑视频合成，或遇到构建/渲染故障时触发。需要 Node.js 22+ 和 FFmpeg。

say.text: 帮我初始化一个名为“广告”的项目
say.note: 运行 init 命令创建项目脚手架。
运行 check 命令，包含 lint 和运行时错误审计。

say.text: 以高质量渲染最终视频
say.note: 运行 render --quality high 输出成品。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use HyperFrames CLI to develop video composition projects: scaffold, author, lint, check, preview, render, and handle cloud rendering, sub-compositions, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or edit a video composition project, or when diagnosing build/render failures. Requires Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg.

say_en.note: Runs init to scaffold the project.

say_en.text: Check the current composition for errors
say_en.note: Runs check, which includes lint and runtime audit.

say_en.text: Render the final video at high quality
say_en.note: Runs render --quality high to produce the output MP4.
